interpretations.rationale: CheckRun 2322bd7884b749f89c3101f04bc82e78 is a completed experiment execution (status completed, exit_code 0, parsing_errors empty, prerequisites matched with alias admission at event indices 0 and 2). Comparison 0 (applicability stale_suffix=false, assertion isolated_caught_up==true) evaluated event index 1 and outcome holds (comparison_complete true): the follower whose log ended below the snapshot index reached applied index 55 = leader commit 55. Comparisons 1 and 2 (applicability stale_suffix=true, assertions isolated_caught_up==true and stalled==false) evaluated event index 3 and outcome violated with valid_witness_indices [3], witness_complete true and comparison_complete true: with snapshot_index=45 below old_last_before=222 the follower stayed at applied index 45 while leader_commit_index was 55 and reported stalled=true, isolated_caught_up=false. interpretations.report_answer: 在保留的 3 节点内存执行中（CheckRun 2322bd7884b749f89c3101f04bc82e78）：对照场景（本机日志末索引 25 低于快照索引 45）比较成立，追随者 applied=55 达到 leader commit=55；缺陷场景（本机日志末索引 222 高于快照索引 45）两条比较被判 violated，witness 为事件 3，追随者 applied 冻结在 45、leader commit=55、stalled=true。原因链：installSnapshot 只清理快照索引及以下的日志、不截断以上后缀也不更新 setLastLog，getLastEntry 继续返回旧的 (lastLogIndex,lastLogTerm)，AppendEntries 的 PrevLogEntry 校验被拒，leader 逐次下调 nextIndex 直至 ErrLogNotFound 并重发同一快照。范围限于单进程内存、非单调存储；未测试重启恢复与安全性，不主张已提交日志丢失。

investigations.question: When a follower installs a snapshot while its persisted log already ends above the snapshot's LastLogIndex, does the follower's last-log report allow the leader's next AppendEntries (PrevLogEntry = snapshot index) to be accepted, or does the leader loop re-transferring the same snapshot with no follower progress?
investigations.hypothesis: installSnapshot restores the FSM, sets lastApplied/lastSnapshot/configuration and compacts logs at or below req.LastLogIndex, but never truncates log entries above req.LastLogIndex and never calls setLastLog. The cached lastLogIndex/lastLogTerm therefore keep the stale suffix, so getLastEntry reports (staleLast, staleTerm) instead of (snapshotIndex, snapshotTerm) whenever lastLogIndex > lastSnapshotIndex. appendEntries then fails the PrevLogEntry==lastIdx branch and either logs.GetLog errors (entries compacted) or returns the stale term, so it rejects with NoRetryBackoff. The leader lowers nextIndex by one (resp.LastLog+1 is above nextIndex-1, so min picks nextIndex-1), and once nextIndex-1 falls below the leader's compacted first index setupAppendEntries returns ErrLogNotFound and the leader re-sends the identical snapshot.
investigations.discriminator: Run the same 3-node in-memory scenario twice: with the isolated node's pre-reconnect last log index below the replacement leader's snapshot index (control, no stale suffix) and above it (case, stale suffix). If the explanation holds the control converges after one install, while the case leaves the isolated node stuck at the snapshot index with leader commit index above it and repeated identical snapshot installs. If the case also converges, the stale-suffix explanation is refuted and the harness or predicate must be revisited.

The follower therefore did not converge to the leader's log after installing the snapshot, while the same code path converged when its log did not extend above the snapshot index. This matches the producer/consumer trace: installSnapshot (raft.go:1814-1953) never truncates log entries above req.LastLogIndex and never calls setLastLog, so getLastEntry (state.go:167-174) keeps reporting the stale (lastLogIndex,lastLogTerm); the AppendEntries PrevLogEntry check (raft.go:1475-1502) rejects with NoRetryBackoff, and replicateTo (replication.go:222-260) lowers nextIndex until setupAppendEntries returns ErrLogNotFound, at which point sendLatestSnapshot (replication.go:299-383) re-sends the same snapshot.

getLastEntry reports the cached log index/term whenever it is at or above the snapshot index
appendEntries rejects on a missing or term-mismatched PrevLogEntry without truncating
replicateTo lowers nextIndex and falls back to re-sending the newest snapshot on ErrLogNotFound
